fixed_threshold_rationale: Prespecified before reading the new test data; .90 and .99 test the false-refusal tradeoff at stringent confidence thresholds. Fixed test diagnostics never choose the baseline threshold.
repeat_type: deterministic forward passes of the same fitted model; no retraining
timing_scope: CPU end-to-end PipelineQA.predict per question; includes linking, classification and fact lookup
timing_note: No warmup is excluded. Machine load and cache state may affect these repeated timings.
